name: Alba Mini Backpack
description: Compact, polished and ready to move. The Alba Mini Backpack pairs a softly rounded profile with a secure zip closure, a front zip pocket and adjustable hands-free straps. The wide-opening interior keeps daily essentials easy to see, with a slip pocket for smaller pieces.
materials: Smooth PU leather with a durable woven lining and gold-tone metal hardware.
care: Wipe clean with a soft, lightly damp cloth. Store filled and upright in a cool, dry place. Avoid prolonged contact with water, oils and dark denim.
